events.description: Requesting all 151936 vocabulary probabilities caused a llama.cpp allocation failure (HTTP 500 bad allocation).

An initial numeric candidate smoke prompt included a leading blank after the assistant generation prefix, making a standalone whitespace token part of candidate tokenization. The numeric candidates were rescored after removing that extra blank, and the corrected prompts and scores are in numeric_candidate_likelihood_smoke_raw.jsonl and numeric_candidate_likelihood_raw.jsonl.

The repaired scorer expanded native exact top-token responses through N=50000. It used a target token only when the backend returned that token's unfiltered logprob. Candidate scores absent from the expanded list remain unavailable.
